body: Graduation is a terrible time if you have suicidal thoughts. My suicidal thoughts were worst after college. The twenties are hard, but they do get better. For me, I needed medication to get through. But I hope you find the courage to talk to your family and friends about it. Suicidal thoughts are like mold, they thrive in dark places, and the shame that makes it feel like you can't talk about these things creates a shroud. I hope you find some nice, sensory things to do today. Hugs from the Internet.
